title: cairn-groundloop-stop-start-restart-status
traces_to: Law 4 (restart enforced by physics — a command — not policy) + Law 1 (the answer to 'how do I restart the ground loop' is settled once)

falsifier.proves_red: RED if the operator still needs raw flag paths or module invocations to manage the ground loop. GREEN when all four subcommands work and the trouble ticket ground-loop-is-older-than-the-code-it-judges can be cleared by `cairn groundloop restart`.

watchme: none, because the ticket proved a one-time operational command set (stop/start/restart/status). Ground loop health is the heartbeat itself.
what: A CLI command `cairn groundloop stop|start|restart|status` that composes with the existing flag-file mechanism and liveness record to give the operator control over the ground loop process.
author: Akien (idea) + CC (cast)

notes.text: Redesigned: the command is 'cairn cairn start' (shortcut 'cairn start'), not 'cairn groundloop'. It launches the ground loop, bus, and shims. The ground loop self-restarts on code change unless prohibited by a flag. No trouble-ticket capability in the ground loop — it is heartbeat + device list, that is all. Nobody else checking on it. Simplification of existing ground loop code to remove trouble-ticket machinery is pre-approved.
